Venue: Biconomy.com
Headline: 🏆 XLA Trading Competition — Share 5,000 XLA!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Dear Biconomy Users,
The XLA Trading Competition is here!
## Trade XLA/USDT on Biconomy and compete for a share of the 5,000 XLA prize pool!
## 📅Activity time
## November 27 — December 03, 2026 (UTC)
## 📝 How to Participate
1. Create or log in to your Biconomy account
2. Register for the campaign: Join Now
3. Trade XLA_USDT during the event period
## 🏁 Competition Rules
## Ranking Calculation
- Ranking is based on total eligible XLA/USDT trading volume (Buy + Sell) during the campaign.
- Only filled orders count toward trading volume. Cancelled or unfilled orders are excluded.
- Tie-breaker: If two or more users have the same eligible trading volume, the user who reaches that volume first will rank higher.
## Eligibility
- Minimum cumulative XLA/USDT trading volume: 500 USDT
- Complete at least 10 filled XLA/USDT trades during the campaign.
## 🎁 Prize Distribution (5,000 XLA):
RANKING | PRIZE | Minimum Trading Volume
🥇 1st Place | 800 XLA | 80,000 USDT
🥈 2nd Place | 550 XLA | 55,000 USDT
🥉 3rd Place | 250 XLA | 25,000 USDT
4th-10th Place | Share 1,400 XLA by Trading Volume | 20,000 USDT
11th – 30th Place | Share 2,000 XLA by Trading Volume | 10,000 USDT
Qualified users will share 5,000 XLA based on their trading volume rankings.
Your Reward = (Your Eligible Trading Volume ÷ Total Eligible Trading Volume of All Qualified Users in the Same Ranking Group) × Corresponding Prize Pool
## Notes
1.You must complete the campaign sign-up on this page to be eligible to participate.
2. Users will be ranked based on their total eligible XLA/USDT trading volume (Buy + Sell) during the campaign period on Biconomy.
3. All rewards will be distributed within 7 business days after the campaign ends.
4. Biconomy reserves the right to disqualify accounts involved in wash trading, self-trading, market manipulation, multi-account abuse, or other fraudulent activities. Such trades will not count toward campaign rankings or rewards.
5. Biconomy reserves the right to the final interpretation of this campaign.
